calibration_details.notes: Partitioned into 3 reliability bins: Low [0, 0.4), Med [0.4, 0.7), High [0.7, 1.0]. Evaluated against Top-1 correctness labels.

cases.case_title: Checkout Latency Surge After Helm Chart Parameter Tweak

hypotheses: Database slow query degradation or missing index on checkout table.
Insufficient API container pod replicas under increased load.
recommended_remediation: Scale checkout-api pods horizontally or increase request timeout thresholds.

hypotheses: Database connection pool starvation caused by deployment configuration capping pool size below concurrency requirements.
PostgreSQL database query latency or lock contention.
recommended_remediation: Restore max_db_connections configuration in Helm chart to 150 and roll out revision.

cases.case_title: Rapid Fulfillment Queue Buildup After Autoscaler Migration

hypotheses: Poison pill message or malformed payload blocking queue consumption.
RabbitMQ broker bottleneck or broker resource starvation.
recommended_remediation: Purge dead-letter queue and restart RabbitMQ broker cluster.

hypotheses: Worker concurrency and replica capacity misconfiguration following autoscaler migration.
Poison pill message blocking consumer worker loop.
recommended_remediation: Scale order-fulfillment-worker replicas to 12 and restore concurrency=8.

cases.case_title: Immediate 502 Bad Gateway Errors on Internal Payment Endpoint

hypotheses: Payment vault upstream service crash or network unreachable.
TLS certificate expiration or cipher mismatch.
recommended_remediation: Restart payment-gateway and vault pods to clear stale sockets.

hypotheses: Downstream internal TLS certificate expired on payment vault endpoint.
Payment vault service crash or container OOMKill.
recommended_remediation: Rotate and reissue TLS certificate for internal-payment-vault via Vault CLI.

cases.case_title: Severe Database Load Following Scheduled Cache Expiry

hypotheses: Redis cache failure or corrupted cache entries requiring flush.
Missing database index on products table causing query timeouts.
recommended_remediation: Flush Redis cache and add a read-replica database.

hypotheses: Cache stampede (dog-piling) on hot featured product keys due to synchronized TTL expiration.
Sudden web crawler spike or malicious traffic volume.
recommended_remediation: Enable single-flight distributed mutex lock on cache misses and introduce +/- 15% TTL jitter.

cases.case_title: Thread Exhaustion and Pod OOM Crashes from Third-Party API Latency

hypotheses: Application memory leak in checkout-orchestrator pods.
External payment partner degradation or network timeout.
recommended_remediation: Increase pod memory limit from 2Gi to 4Gi and restart pods.

hypotheses: Third-party payment partner latency causing cascading thread and socket exhaustion due to missing circuit breaker.
Internal memory leak in checkout orchestrator application runtime.
recommended_remediation: Activate emergency circuit breaker fallback to secondary payment provider (Stripe rail) and set 3s timeout.

cases.case_title: Static Assets Returning HTTP 403 on CDN Edge (Novel Incident)

hypotheses: S3 bucket IAM policy or ACL misconfiguration revoking CDN origin access.
Cloudflare / CDN SSL or host header configuration mismatch.
recommended_remediation: Revert Terraform IAM policy changes to restore s3:GetObject permission for CDN origin principal.

hypotheses: S3 bucket IAM policy or ACL misconfiguration revoking CDN origin access.

recommended_remediation: Revert Terraform IAM policy changes to restore s3:GetObject permission for CDN origin principal.

cases.case_title: Checkout Latency Spike Caused by Database Lock Contention (Different Root Cause)

hypotheses: Long-running exclusive table lock and lock contention during online DDL migration, NOT connection pool exhaustion.
Database connection pool starvation or thread exhaustion.
recommended_remediation: Identify and terminate blocking DDL migration PID via pg_cancel_backend() or pg_terminate_backend().

hypotheses: Long-running exclusive table lock and lock contention during online DDL migration, NOT connection pool exhaustion.

cases.case_title: Authentication Service 500 Errors from CoreDNS Resolution Failures

hypotheses: CoreDNS cluster resolution degradation causing lookup timeouts on Identity Provider hostname.
External Identity Provider downtime or TLS handshake rejection.
recommended_remediation: Rollback CoreDNS autoscaler configmap and restart coredns pods in kube-system namespace.

cases.case_title: Inventory Processing Stalls from Silent VPC Packet Loss (Missing Deployment Context)

hypotheses: VPC network interface MTU mismatch or packet loss between worker subnet and database subnet.
Database instance resource exhaustion or disk IOPS throttling.
recommended_remediation: Inspect AWS VPC flow logs and verify MTU path settings between worker subnet and DB subnet.

hypotheses: VPC network interface MTU mismatch or packet loss between worker subnet and database subnet.

cases.case_title: Order Fulfillment Backlog from CPU-Bound Invoice PDF Generation (Conflicting Evidence)

hypotheses: CPU-bound vector PDF invoice rendering library saturating worker compute capacity, NOT worker replica reduction.
Worker concurrency capacity reduction or queue consumer starvation.
recommended_remediation: Rollback DEP-9380 vector PDF invoice dependency or offload PDF generation to dedicated async task queue.

cases.case_title: Product Catalog Slowdown on Memory-Constrained Nodes (Unsafe Historical Fix)

hypotheses: Missing GIN index on jsonb attributes column under high search traffic with cluster NodeMemoryPressure.
Cluster node memory leak in kubelet or containerd.
recommended_remediation: Create concurrent GIN index on products attributes column; do NOT scale pods horizontally due to node memory pressure.

cases.case_title: Streaming Event Pipeline Ingestion Freeze from Kafka Partition Rebalance Storm

hypotheses: Kafka consumer rebalance storm caused by consumer batch size increase exceeding max.poll.interval.ms.
Kafka broker cluster zookeeper/kraft quorum failure.
recommended_remediation: Revert max.poll.records to 500 or increase max.poll.interval.ms to 600000ms.

hypotheses: Application heap memory leak in Jackson JSON parser buffers introduced in library upgrade causing rolling container OOMKills.
Database connection thread leak in payment gateway.
recommended_remediation: Rollback DEP-9490 Jackson databind library version to stable release 2.16.2.

cases.case_title: Cascading Service Failure from Unbounded Retry Storm on Degraded User Profile API

hypotheses: Unbounded client retry storm without exponential backoff or jitter saturating downstream profile service.
Downstream user profile database disk I/O exhaustion.
recommended_remediation: Re-enable exponential backoff delay and jitter on checkout HTTP client retry policy and set max retries to 2.

cases.case_title: Contradictory Historical Guidance on Redis Cache Eviction vs Failover

hypotheses: Redis memory eviction thrashing under volatile-lru policy causing latency spikes; requires keyspace memory increase or TTL optimization, NOT flushall.
PostgreSQL primary database read saturation.
recommended_remediation: Adjust maxmemory-policy or scale Redis memory capacity; avoid flushing cache.

cases.case_title: Ambiguous Partial Outage with Conflicting Network vs Database Metrics

hypotheses: Intermittent cross-rack network packet drop causing idle TCP resets, but telemetry is incomplete and requires uncertainty acknowledgment.
Database idle transaction timeout or connection pool reaper timeout.
recommended_remediation: Deploy tcpdump network probe to capture cross-AZ reset packets before taking destructive action.
